newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch activists to blockade Schiphol Oct 27.
newsitem.headline: Dutch activists to blockade Schiphol Oct 27.

text.p: Environmental lobby group Milieudefensie said on Monday it was pressing ahead with plans to disrupt flights at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport on October 27 in protest at the continued growth in air traffic.
"The protest will effectively close down the airport for two hours, blocking around 60 flights," a spokeswoman said.
Schiphol said management was holding internal consultations on the issue and would respond in due course.
Milieudefensie said it had applied to the local council for permission to stage the protest and a decision was expected on Thursday.
The council was not immediately available for comment.
Milieudefensie said that on Sunday October 27 around 500 activists would float aluminium-coated hot-air balloons and kites from various points around the airport terrain.
These would block runway visibility and scramble radar signals, spokewoman Sylvia Doodeman said. The two-hour protest is scheduled to start at 1400 hours local time.
The environmental group, an affiliate of Britain's Friends of the Earth, in November blocked an airport runway in protest at Schiphol's expansion plans.
